entry_title: 評価日・時変情報の見方
intended_meaning: Each entry describes information as of its evaluation date. Optional version_status and pricing_note fields describe time-varying facts; when either is present, its source note must also record a checked date.
must_keep: exactly three distinct groups: required evaluation_date, optional version_status, optional pricing_note
one calendar-and-clock pictogram as the evaluation_date group itself
one shared checked-date cue for the two optional groups without a duplicate calendar
unselected abstract status dots and an unbranded pricing-tag outline; imply no specific value
remove: incidental people and pet robot not required by the A-6 brief
books, plant, mug, laptop, desks, and scene props
duplicate dashboards, repeated timelines, charts, miniature card stacks, unrelated connector arrows
gray dashboard fills and unapproved hues
pseudo-text, labels, dates, numbers, currency marks, and watermarks
